verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence publishes a paper, fax, or mail filing route for Secretary of State business filings, with no mailing addresses, fax numbers, or printable SOS forms. The only nearby items are the Department of Taxation's tax forms library and its in-person Welcome Center, which belong to a different agency surface and do not document a fallback for business filings. The ohiosos.gov and Ohio Business Central sites returned 403 at robots.txt, so no first-party fallback documentation could be confirmed.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable
